dialogueInline.speaker: Merchant
dialogueInline.text: Our ration shelves are empty. Where's the grain?

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: The relief freighter has a hundred crates. It hasn't cleared the corridor.

dialogueInline.speaker: Crew
dialogueInline.text: People are waiting at every berth.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Distribute what we have. Don't count the freighter until it docks.

dialogueInline.speaker: Merchant
dialogueInline.text: Can your escorts bring it in?

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: The last window closed before it reached the approach.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Can Jex find another?

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: He tracks the live openings. I'll get one the pilot can use.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: The old passage chart won't get that freighter through. I need a current window.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Three verified openings. The timing shifts when the shear does.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Who gets the updates?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Paying pilots. Until now.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: The Triarch tankers cut our fuel. We've barely enough for another patrol.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: And the ration lockers are nearly empty.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Saville ordered a hold on civilian traffic.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: That freighter has food. Take the aft rack. Keep fire off its bridge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: The aft rack's gone. The rest is still aboard.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Keep her drive intact. I want the remaining cargo.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Gravefire's moving across our next shot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: Break off. You've already hit them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: My crew's on half rations. There's still food aboard.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: So are the families waiting for it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: You'll burn your patched radiator to stand in my way?

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Would you fire on me?

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: I don't want to find out. Turn away, Billie.

panelPlan: Gravefire moves its still-scored port side between the already-hit freighter and Ashfang. Tess warns Billie off over the open Shard channel.
On Gravefire's bridge, Tess and her crew monitor rapidly declining cooling reserves. Billie's face is visible only on a small live comm display as they argue over the food aboard the freighter.
Billie challenges Tess over comm; Tess holds position despite the radiator danger. The freighter stays behind Gravefire while the two captains face the possibility of firing on one another.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Our holds are still empty.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Break pursuit. We're leaving.

dialogueInline.speaker: Guard
dialogueInline.text: I was told to clear the chalk.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: That arrow leads to the open ration door.

dialogueInline.speaker: Guard
dialogueInline.text: The old sign points west.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: West is locked. Move the sign.

dialogueInline.speaker: Loader
dialogueInline.text: Rusk used your window to hit that freighter.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: The freighter needed it too. I didn't sell Rusk the right to shoot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Loader
dialogueInline.text: Tell that to the people waiting for grain. What do I tell the next pilot?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Bring me the next fix. I'll post it on the open band, whether anyone pays or not.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Admiralty extended your field command for this freight escort. No offensive release.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Banks is holding that line with a damaged port radiator.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Gravefire still shows Shard hostile.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Keep the designation. Give her civilian overlap and cover her exposed side.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Rusk hit the food freighter. Banks stopped the next pass.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Cut Ashfang off our shared escort tracks. Tell every captain why.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: Rusk has scouts of her own.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Then our captains won't be the ones guiding her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Seventy-two crates on the dock. We lost twenty-eight with the aft rack.

dialogueInline.speaker: Luminara Boy
dialogueInline.text: My mother walked to the depot twice yesterday. Does our block still get a delivery?

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Not what we promised. We'll divide what's here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: No one should walk to an empty depot again. I'll post the real allotment for each block.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: The next freighter gets an escort. I'll count its food when it docks.

panelPlan: Workers count the 72 actually delivered crates, with Halev checking the manifest for a hundred and the torn aft rack evidence beside them.
The Luminara Boy asks Halev about his block while adults work out how to divide supplies actually present, not promised.
Sera records the missing twenty-eight crates by district instead of claiming delivery, while Naomi prepares a real escort for the next incoming shipment.

dialogueInline.speaker: Woman
dialogueInline.text: The east ration door's open!

dialogueInline.speaker: Man
dialogueInline.text: They sent us west an hour ago.

dialogueInline.speaker: Woman
dialogueInline.text: Dock crew changed the arrow. I came through east myself.

dialogueInline.speaker: Emissary
dialogueInline.text: Patrols wiped two boards. The times turned up at five more crossings.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fear Mask
dialogueInline.text: Who keeps correcting them?

dialogueInline.speaker: Emissary
dialogueInline.text: Pilots. Dock crews. People who used the route.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fear Mask
dialogueInline.text: Find the couriers. Give Trade the cargo lanes they depend on.
